title.narrative: scaling-up access to HIV prevention, treatment, care and support services for vulnerable groups in the civilian and penitentiary sectors through enhanced and expanded governmental/NGO/private parnerships - Kazakhstan (01-Jan-2014-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Kazakhstan, HIV, Kazakh scientific center of dermatology and infectious diseases of the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Kazakhstan (KSCDID)This program has the following goals: To achieve the greatest impact of HIV control by increasing PWIDsâ€™ access to a comprehensive package of harm reduction services in civil and prison sectors. The objectives of this program are: Increasing access to evidence-based HIV prevention and treatment in prisons. Scaling up the OST in the civil sector. Strengthening the capacity of communities to ensure program sustainability and expansion of services provided to MARPs. Strengthening the HIV infection control by implementing measures aimed at improving an access to integrated package of harm reduction services. Strengthening the monitoring and evaluation systems.
